transforms.sql: create table customer_entities as select c.customer_id,c.region,count(o.order_id) as order_count,coalesce(sum(o.paid_cents-o.refund_cents),0) as net_cents from raw_customers c left join raw_orders o on c.customer_id=o.customer_id group by c.customer_id,c.region

create table daily_metrics as select order_day,count(*) as orders,count(distinct customer_id) as customers,sum(paid_cents) as paid_cents,sum(refund_cents) as refund_cents,sum(paid_cents-refund_cents) as net_cents,sum(late) as late_orders from raw_orders group by order_day
create table decision_candidates as select order_day,late_orders,orders,'INVESTIGATE_FULFILLMENT' as proposed_action from daily_metrics where late_orders*100>orders*10
